summary: Master project leadership and management with our expert-led course. Improve your communication skills and drive successful projects from start to finish.
lede: Project leadership training helps project professionals guide delivery by aligning people, plans and priorities. For project managers, team leads and others working in project environments, it covers setting goals and allocating resources, engaging stakeholders through clear communication, and identifying risks and resolving conflicts as conditions change.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to lead, manage, and communicate effectively in project environments.
modules: Adapting to Change and Leading in Uncertainty
